data.name: Balaj
data.gender_notes: Balaj is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'balajah' meaning 'a powerful warrior'. This name is often given to boys in the Muslim world who are expected to grow up to be strong and courageous. The name Balaj carries the meaning “Powerful, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Balaj usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength and the ability to overcome challenges with bravery and resilience.
data.etymology: Balaj belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balaj total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
